name: green-zone-straddle-bottom-equality
note: TRUTH TABLE ROW — exact retest of the BOTTOM edge, the mirror of green-zone-straddle-top-equality. Bar 2 probes low=90 (EXACTLY the bottom edge), high=100. `touch` terminates at bar 2 and mitigates; `straddle` does not, because low < bottom is false at equality. The second of the two rows that separate the predicates, and the second row a <= mutation of the straddle branch must fail. Both edges are tested and OR'd, exactly as touch does, so covering only the top edge would leave half the predicate unguarded.
source:
indicator("SB", shorttitle="SB", overlay=true)
spawn = bar_index == 0
plotzone(spawn, high, low, "T", extend=extend.until, terminate=terminate.touch, mitigated_color=color.gray)
plotzone(spawn, high, low, "S", extend=extend.until, terminate=terminate.straddle, mitigated_color=color.gray)
